name: speech-act
description: Design scholarly writing and explanation as situated actions addressed to human readers.

interface.shortDescription: Design structure, sequence, and vocabulary around what the text does for its readers.
interface.longDescription: Speech act theory, pragmatics, academic rhetoric, and human–AI writing practice inform a concrete workflow for planning, revising, and reviewing reader-facing prose.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $speech-act:speech-act-writing to design or revise this text around what it enables its intended reader to understand, judge, question, or do.
